---
title: "A page image keeps the size the page declares for it"
open-graph:
  image: square.svg
  image-width: 10
  image-height: 10
_quarto:
  render-project: true
  tests:
    html:
      ensureFileRegexMatches:
        -
          - '<meta property="og:image" content="https://example.com/square.svg">'
          - '<meta property="og:image:height" content="10">'
          - '<meta property="og:image:width" content="10">'
        - []
---

Quarto cannot measure an SVG, so the size declared next to the page image is used.
